title: FamilySpace: From Emergent Chemical Semantics to Controllable Crystal Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent crystal generative models typically combine a variational autoencoder (VAE) for learning atom-wise representations with a flow model that transports a simple source distribution to the learned latent distribution. However, previous studies have mainly focused on the quality of generated crystals, leaving the structure and generative utility of the atom-wise latent space largely unexplored. In this work, we show that even a vanilla crystal VAE implicitly organizes atom-wise latent representations according to elemental families, with different families occupying largely separated regions of the latent space. We term this phenomenon emergent chemical semantics. This structure suggests that sampling from a family-specific latent region can bias the decoder toward atoms from the corresponding elemental family. Building on this insight, we propose FamilySpace, a framework for controlling the elemental-family composition of generated cr

translated_title: FamilySpace：从涌现的化学语义到可控晶体生成
translated_abstract: 潜空间晶体生成模型通常将用于学习原子级表示的变分自编码器（VAE）与流模型相结合，流模型负责将简单的源分布传输到学习到的潜空间分布。然而，以往的研究主要关注生成晶体的质量，而对原子级潜空间的结构及其生成效用基本未加探索。在这项工作中，我们证明了即使是普通的晶体VAE，也会隐式地按照元素族来组织原子级潜空间表示，不同的元素族占据潜空间中大致分离的区域。我们将这一现象称为“涌现的化学语义”。这种结构表明，从特定元素族的潜空间区域进行采样，可以使解码器偏向生成来自相应元素族的原子。基于这一见解，我们提出了FamilySpace，一个用于控制生成晶体元素族组成的框架。
tldr: 该论文发现晶体VAE的原子级潜空间会按元素族自发地组织出分离区域（即“涌现的化学语义”），并据此提出FamilySpace框架，通过从特定元素族的潜空间区域采样来控制生成晶体的元素族组成。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that a vanilla crystal VAE implicitly organizes atom-wise latent representations by elemental families ("emergent chemical semantics"), and builds on this insight to propose FamilySpace, a framework that controls the elemental-family composition of generated crystals by sampling from family-specific latent regions.
